players.product: blank masks for semiconductor and display photomasks (EUV blank mask in mass-production preparation; EUV pellicle in development)

quarterly_data.signal: August 2026 IR deck: EUV blank-mask evaluation samples have been supplied to leading global customers under strategic collaboration and qualification is ongoing; upon qualification, full-scale production and capacity expansion will follow. The deck's roadmap lists EUV blank-mask mass-production commercialization and EUV pellicle commercialization as upcoming (2026 onward). The EUV pellicle is a sub-20nm tri-layer Si-based membrane made at full production size, assembled with an in-house pellicle and in-house frame. Sites: Yongin EUV Center (completed 2025-10-15; land 8,250 m2, clean room 3,630 m2; EUV products) and Daegu HQ (land 13,200 m2, clean room 5,450 m2; optical blank masks and EUV products). The company serves around 30 customers worldwide, including China and Taiwan; H1 2026 exports were KRW 71.0 B, 55.5% of consolidated revenue.
